blocks.orig: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon your arrival at Dar es Salaam Airport, our friendly and knowledgeable guide will be eagerly waiting to warmly welcome you. He will be readily available to assist you and ensure a smooth transfer to your hotel. Sit back, relax, and let us take care of all your travel needs, providing you with a memorable and unforgettable experience in Tanzania.
blocks.html: Welcome to Tanzania! When you land at Dar es Salaam Airport, our friendly guide, who knows the country well, is waiting to give you a warm welcome. He is there to help you and to make sure your transfer to the hotel goes smoothly. Sit back and relax while we look after everything you need, so your time in Tanzania becomes a memorable experience.

blocks.orig: Nyerere National Park is a huge and beautiful national park in the south of Tanzania, boasting a river, a jungle, and a large number of animals such as lions, leopards, hippos, crocodiles, Maasai giraffes and even a few black rhinos and African wild dogs. From Dar Es Salaam you fly to this amazing park, where you can do safaris by car, boat, or foot. The Rufiji River, which crosses the entire reserve, and the massive Stiegler Gorge are not to be missed!
blocks.html: In the south of Tanzania lies Nyerere National Park, a vast and lovely park with a river, jungle and plenty of animals, including lions, leopards, hippos, crocodiles, Maasai giraffes and even some black rhinos and African wild dogs. You fly from Dar Es Salaam to this remarkable park, where safaris are possible by car, by boat or on foot. Make sure you see the Rufiji River, which runs through the whole reserve, and the enormous Stiegler Gorge!

blocks.orig: A boat safari on the Rufiji River in Nyerere National Park is both relaxing and adventurous! The boat takes you over the river and to nearby lakes, allowing you to spot many animals that come to the water’s edge. Very common are giraffes, impalas, waterbucks, kudus and warthogs. Sometimes, also bathing elephants or crocodiles can be seen, and always, the many bird species sound their voices. The trip includes a picnic lunch on the shores of one of the lakes.
blocks.html: Going on a boat safari on the Rufiji River in Nyerere National Park is relaxing and adventurous at the same time! You glide along the river and on to lakes nearby, with good chances of seeing the many animals that gather at the water’s edge. Giraffes, impalas, waterbucks, kudus and warthogs are seen often. Now and then elephants or crocodiles are bathing too, and the calls of the many bird species are always in the air. A picnic lunch on the shore of one of the lakes is part of the trip.

blocks.orig: This morning you board a small aircraft and fly to Ruaha National Park. It is a short flight, which makes it possible to do a first game drive right upon arrival! Ruaha National Park is the third largest national park in Tanzania. It lies along the Great Ruaha River, is known for its large elephant population, and is a true paradise for birdwatchers. Game drives are special, as you drive through an untouched and unexplored ecosystem in this relatively quiet but stunning park!
blocks.html: This morning a small plane takes you to Ruaha National Park. As the flight is short, you can go on your first game drive as soon as you arrive! Ruaha National Park ranks as the third largest national park in Tanzania. Set along the Great Ruaha River, it is famous for its many elephants and is a real haven for birdwatchers. Game drives feel special here, as you travel through an unspoilt and unexplored ecosystem in a fairly quiet yet beautiful park!

blocks.orig: Ruaha National Park is the third largest national park in Tanzania. It lies along the Great Ruaha River, is known for its large elephant population, and is a true paradise for birdwatchers with over 570 species. Besides, you might catch a glimpse of lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, crocodiles, elands, sable antelopes, jackals, or the rare African wild dog. Game drives are special, as you drive through an untouched ecosystem in this relatively quiet but stunning park!
blocks.html: Ruaha National Park ranks as the third largest national park in Tanzania. Set along the Great Ruaha River, it is famous for its many elephants and, with more than 570 species, it is a real haven for birdwatchers. You may also see lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, crocodiles, elands, sable antelopes, jackals or the rare African wild dog. Game drives feel special here, as you travel through an unspoilt ecosystem in a fairly quiet yet beautiful park!

blocks.orig: This is your last day! Today you fly to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam, from where you will catch your international flight home. Having second thoughts? Then don't hesitate to extend your holiday to one of Tanzania's paradise islands such as Zanzibar, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day has come! Today you fly to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam to board your international flight home. Not ready to leave? Then feel free to add some time on one of Tanzania's paradise islands, such as Zanzibar, Pemba or Mafia!
